title: The determinant n-covector of ℝⁿ: every n-covector is α(e)·ε, and ε = ±1 on orthonormal bases
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, ℝⁿ = Euclid n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), and let e = (e₁, …, eₙ) = ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) be the standard orthonormal basis. There is an n-covector ε ∈ Covector (Euclid n) n (a continuous alternating n-linear form on ℝⁿ) with three properties. (i) ε(e) = 1. (ii) α(v) = ε(v)·α(e) for every n-covector α and every v : Fin n → ℝⁿ. (iii) ε(τ) = 1 or ε(τ) = −1 for every orthonormal family τ : Fin n → ℝⁿ whose span is ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ ε : Covector (Euclid n) n, ε ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ) = 1 ∧ (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid n) n) (v : Fin n → Euclid n), α v = ε v * α ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ)) ∧ ∀ τ : Fin n → Euclid n, Orthonormal ℝ τ → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) = ⊤ → ε τ = 1 ∨ ε τ = -1
